gate_type: IMPLEMENTATION gate — Canonical Same-Session Observation / MES Output Reintegration. The ONLY authorized implementation gate.
architecture_authority_ref: https://github.com/hieudovn/virtual-factory/issues/78 (R0 CLOSED, frozen) + Issue #80 (R2 CLOSED; accepted base 4fc81e72780fe14ba5532407fdc8113b44385617) + Issue #82 (R2V PASS, ASSY_RICH_SIMULATION_VALIDATED)
objective: Restore ASSY outbound Observation/MES/data projection on top of the SAME canonical TIPA RuntimeSession accepted in R1/R2: WorkspaceMonitor -> ONE TIPA RuntimeSession -> AssyExecutionBridge -> TipaAssyFederation -> exactly 6 AssyLineRuntime truths -> READ-ONLY observation/output projection (ObservationService/ObservationRouter, MESProjection/ProjectedMessage, in-memory/demo gateway evidence). No output path may construct, own, advance, reset or fork simulation truth. Carry canonical run/session identity (workspace_id, canonical run_id, pinned scenario_id/profile id, sub_line/scope, simulation time, provenance=simulation/synthetic) with the legacy sub-line-local source key retained only as a subordinate compatibility key. Re-enable /assy-demo/observations, /assy-demo/mes-messages, /assy-demo/mes-trace as canonical non-deferred endpoints. AP05 jam/recover/run-to-terminal/OEE and scenario mutation stay deferred to R4. Transport scope stays demo/in-memory only.
explicit_non_objectives: No R5 runtime consolidation / generic legacy simulator consolidation
No gateway/protocol expansion (production MQTT/Kafka/OPC/REST routing, store-forward, multi-gateway)
No rewrite of AssyLineRuntime or ASSY domain facts
No R1 production driver or generic G4 coordinator change
No change to G22 reset/new-attempt/replay run identity semantics
No new observation/MES model invented for vNext
forbidden_actions: Create a second runtime/session/federation/controller on any output path
stop_conditions: Existing Observation/MES contracts cannot carry canonical run identity without a breaking redesign
Correct reset idempotency requires changing G22 run identity semantics
Reuse requires legacy controller/composition to remain active authority
Output reintegration requires stepping/mutating simulation during poll

acceptance_criteria.description: Same-session output identity: shell, rich UI and output adapter reference the same canonical RuntimeSession.run_id and the same six runtime objects; exactly one federation; no legacy controller
Observation facts emitted from canonical runtime truth (operation completion, AP04 genealogy, AP06/AP08 quality, AP11 final QC/release) with canonical run provenance
MES message families produced from canonical truth with canonical run identity in message identity/provenance
Idempotency: repeated poll without stepping delivers no duplicates; step-then-poll yields only newly available facts/messages

Lifecycle projection safety: reset of the same canonical run id uses a fresh projection epoch without pre-reset collision; new_attempt/replay fresh run ids get fresh output namespaces; no checkpoint carry-over
Held-one/five-continue reflected in output: held sub-line emits no new time-dependent facts while the other five still progress/output; release resumes coherently
No simulation mutation by the output path: polling does not change step count, simulation time, WIP, genealogy or quality state and never constructs legacy authority
/assy-demo/observations, /mes-messages, /mes-trace return canonical non-deferred data with canonical run identity (no 503, legacy_runtime_authority false)
R1/R2 regression preserved: R1 + R2 suites green, observation/MES contract regressions green, full suite and complete canonical baseline green
